The '''Onderia system''' was located in the [[Lantillian sector/Legends|Lantillian sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]] of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system was the origin point of the beverage known as [[Ondaran willek juice]].<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Ondaran willek juice]]|system=Ondara [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ondara system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square P-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
